# Air Purifiers R Us

> > Air Purifiers R Us offers factory-direct HEPA and chemical filtration solutions from Espitech's Quatro Air systems, serving healthcare, industrial, and commercial applications with medical-grade air quality technology.

Air Purifiers R Us specializes in comprehensive air purification systems featuring HEPA filtration, activated carbon, and multi-stage technology for infection control, VOC removal, and particle filtration. The site showcases applications across healthcare, data centers, manufacturing, and specialized environments like IVF labs and laser engraving facilities.

## Key Topics

- HEPA filtration
- Activated carbon
- VOC removal
- Odor control
- Multi-stage filtration
- Infection control
- Medical-grade purifiers
- Chemical-gas removal
- Particle filtration
- Indoor air quality
- Fume extraction
- BH400
- BP Series
- AF Series
- Cleanroom technology
